# metronome_billable_metric (Resource)

A billable metric: a query that filters and aggregates usage events into a quantity that can be priced.

~> **Only the name can change.** Metronome fixes a metric's definition when it is created, so changing anything else **replaces** the metric: a new one is created and the old one archived. A product that used the old metric keeps metering with it until it is pointed at the new one, which `metronome_product` does in place.

~> **Destroying a metric archives it.** Metronome has no delete. An archived metric still meters for the products that already use it and cannot be given to another; it cannot be restored.

Define the metric either with `aggregation_type` and the filters (a streaming metric), or with `sql`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The seconds each session was awake, added up.
resource "metronome_billable_metric" "awake_seconds" {
  name             = "cu_awake_seconds_v1"
  aggregation_type = "SUM"
  aggregation_key  = "seconds"
  event_type_filter = {
    in_values = ["session.awake"]
  }
  property_filters = [{ name = "seconds", exists = true }]
  group_keys       = [["session_id"]]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name. Changed in place.

### Optional

- `aggregation_key` (String) The event property that is aggregated. It must be the `name` of one of `property_filters`. Not used with `COUNT`. Changing it replaces the metric.
- `aggregation_type` (String) How matching events are aggregated: `COUNT`, `LATEST`, `MAX`, `SUM` or `UNIQUE`. Changing it replaces the metric.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom fields, set when the metric is created. The keys must already exist in the account. Changing them replaces the metric.
- `event_type_filter` (Attributes) Which events match, by their `event_type`. Changing it replaces the metric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event_type_filter))
- `group_keys` (List of List of String) Sets of property names by which usage can be grouped, for pricing or for presentation on an invoice. At most five. Changing them replaces the metric.
- `property_filters` (Attributes List) Rules on the properties of an event; all must pass for the event to match. Changing them replaces the metric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--property_filters))
- `sql` (String) The query of a SQL billable metric. Excludes `aggregation_type`, `aggregation_key`, the filters and `group_keys`. Changing it replaces the metric.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The metric's Metronome ID.

<a id="nestedatt--event_type_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `event_type_filter`

Optional:

- `in_values` (List of String) Only events of these types match.
- `not_in_values` (List of String) Events of these types do not match.


<a id="nestedatt--property_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `property_filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the event property.

Optional:

- `exists` (Boolean) `true`: only events that have the property match. `false`: only events that do not.
- `in_values` (List of String) The property's value must be one of these.
- `not_in_values` (List of String) The property's value must be none of these.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import metronome_billable_metric.awake_seconds 13117714-3f05-48e5-a6e9-a66093f13b4d
```
